content: Ofa ŋaiye somohonme yukur ka se ongohe pupwa

Wusyep erŋeme tikin Moses pe, poi tatame ŋaiye ya metekeꞌe yipihinge ŋaiꞌe ŋaiꞌe bwore bwore ŋaiye mindemboi ka ot. Kom yukur ki pasam poi ŋaiꞌe ŋaiꞌe luku bworerme. Wusyep erŋeme ki ŋanange nange tinge ka yende ofa ŋahilyeh junde tuꞌe luku wahtaip ilyeh ilyeh. Taꞌe luku pe, poi sisyeme nange wusyep erŋeme yukur ka se ungwisme lenge miyeꞌ tuweinge ŋaiye ka tuhur bwore prihe no, ka yil sehei me Got, pakai.

Lenge miyeꞌ tuweinge ŋaiye yirisukwarme Got pe, ofa lenge pris yukur ŋende tinge tahar bwore prihe yasme hwap pupwa ŋaiye tinge yende luku pe, yukur tinge ŋoihsipe hwap ŋaiye tinge si yende. Taꞌe luku pe, yaŋah ŋaiye yende ofa yukur ka miꞌe.
Wahtaip ilyeh ilyeh pe, ofa luku plihe ŋende ŋoihmbwaip tinge ŋoiheryembe yal hwap ŋaiye tinge si yende.
Wim ŋaiye yowor kau tuhwim topoꞌe yowor meme yukur tatame ŋaiye ka se ongohe hwap pupwa.
Taꞌe luku pe, ŋupe ŋaiye Krais nate gah kekep pe, kin ŋaname Got taꞌe leꞌe,

content.text: Ni garnge ŋaiye ka yonombe yowor ende no, ka yende ofa.
Kom nin si ŋende miꞌmiꞌ me wahriꞌ ŋam ŋaiye ma gunde nin.
Ofa lalme ŋaiye tinge yesekeh yal nih no, nih ono lalme,
topoꞌe ofa lalme ŋaiye nongohe hwap pe, ni ŋanange pakai.

content: Taꞌe luku pe, tukwini ŋam manange taꞌe leꞌe,

content.text: Got, ŋam si mat miꞌe. Ki taꞌe ŋaiye somohon tinge yainge wusyep
me ŋam ya jah tup.
Ŋam si mat miꞌe ŋaiye ma gunde ŋasande nin.

content: Ŋendehei kin pe, kin ŋanange wusyep me ofa tetehei ŋaiye wusyep erŋeme ki ŋanange ŋaiye ka yende. Kom kin ŋanange taꞌe leꞌe, “Nin garnge ŋaiye ka yonombe yowor yende ofa. Nin yukur hriphrip me ofa ŋaiye tinge yesekeh lalme yal nih, topoꞌe ofa ŋaiye nongohe hwap pupwa.”
Miꞌe pe, kin plihe ŋanange taꞌe leꞌe, “Ŋam si mat ŋaiye ma gunde ŋasande nin.” Taꞌe luku pe, kin ginyenme ofa yerkeime luku nal ko, kin nember ofa tikin Krais nambaꞌe luh ofa yerkeime.

Jisas Krais gande ŋoihmbwaip tikin Got pe, kin naŋaꞌe wahriꞌ kitikin taꞌe ofa ŋaiye kin nule nilyeh nal loutungwarmbe. Kin ŋende yaŋah uku pe, poi lalme marp miyeꞌ tuweinge tikin Got pe, poi marp holi, bwore mise supule.
Ofa tikin Krais pe, ki tatame ka ongohe hwap lalme
Lenge pris yate jan pe, tinge yende wah tinge ŋup ilyeh ilyeh. Tinge yende ofa luku ni wula wula, kom ofa luku yukur ka se ongohe hwap lalme.
Kom ofa ŋilyeh Krais pe, ki nongohe hwap lalme pe, ofa luku se ka si nye nyermbe. Kin ŋende taꞌe luku miꞌe pe, kin nal narp syep non tikin Got.
Kin narp neseperhme Got ŋaiye ka ember lenge wachaih kin ka yurp tuwihme kin.
Krais si ŋende ofa me lenge miyeꞌ tuweinge ŋaiye Got si nalaŋatme. Kin si ŋende lenge ŋaiye tinge tahar holi, bwore mise supule jande ofa esep ilyeh uku pe, tinge ka yurp tuꞌe luku nye nyermbe.
Yohe Yirise topoꞌe plihe ŋanange wusyep natme poi na,
“Lahmborenge ŋanange taꞌe leꞌe,

content.text: Kontrak ŋambaran eꞌe ŋaiye mindemboi ma mupwaiꞌe motop tinge pe,
ki taꞌe leꞌe:
ma member wusyep erŋeme ŋam lalme mi moto ŋoihmbwaip tinge,
topoꞌe ma minge wusyep erŋeme mi moto ŋoihmbwaip tinge.”

content: Miꞌe pe, kin plihe ŋanange taꞌe leꞌe,

content.text: Ma mongohe hwap tinge pe,
yukur ma plihe ŋoiheryembe hwap tinge luku.

content: Taꞌe luku pe, ŋaiye Got si nongohe hwap lenge miyeꞌ tuweinge pe, wah lenge pris ŋaiye yende ofa si miꞌe.
Ŋoihmbwaip poi ka teŋeime Got bongol pe, ya mil sehei me kin
Lenge toꞌ tatai, wim tikin Jisas si nongohe hwap poi lalme. Taꞌe luku pe, poi tatame ŋaiye ya mi moto Luh Holi ŋaiye tikin Holi Supule nato Yokoh tikin Got pe, yukur ya hiꞌ worhe.
Jisas ŋende ŋahwikin ambaran me poi ŋaiye ya murp laip. Kin naŋaꞌe wahriꞌ kin taꞌe ofa pe, kin ginyenme ŋaiꞌe ŋaiꞌe ŋaiye nupwaiꞌe poi ŋaiye ya mil moi tikin Got.
Pris ondoh poi bepteme yokoh tikin Got nanah moihlaꞌ.

Kin nangalai wim kin nate ŋanah ŋoihmbwaip poi pe, kin nongohe hwap pupwa poi ŋaiye mende pe, tinge pangaih poi pinip. Taꞌe luku pe, poi sisyeme nange poi marp bwore miꞌ supule mal ŋembep tikin Got. Pe ŋoihmbwaip poi ka prihe supule no, ka teŋeime Got bongol pe, ya mil sehei me kin.

Poi ya mininge moworꞌe ember ŋaimune ŋaiye ŋoihmbwaip poi teŋeime, topoꞌe ŋaiꞌe ŋaiꞌe bwore bwore ŋaiye poi marp meseperhme. Poi sisyeme nange ŋaiꞌe ŋaiꞌe lalme ŋaiye Got si nupwaiꞌe wusyep nange ka ende pe, se ka ende.
Poi ilyeh ilyeh ya plihe ŋoihmeryembe lenge miyeꞌ tuweinge tikin Got pe, ya mini lenge mahraꞌe ŋoihmbwaip tinge ŋaiye ka yende niharar lenge mitiŋ, topoꞌe ka yasamb lenge ŋoihmbwaip bwore.

Poi lenge miyeꞌ tuweinge tikin Got pe, yukur ya musme ŋoihmbwaip ŋaiye ya lalme mute guhilyeh tuꞌe lenge miyeꞌ tuweinge syeꞌ ŋaiye yende. Poi sisyeme nange ŋup tikin Krais ŋaiye ka ot pe, si nat sehei. Taꞌe luku pe, poi ilyeh ilyeh ya mende wah nihe ŋaiye ya mininge wusyep mende bongolme ŋoihmbwaip lenge miyeꞌ tuweinge tikin Got.
Poi yukur ya maŋaꞌe teket me Talah tikin Got
Ŋaiye poi si masande wusyep mise tikin Krais, kom poi plihe ma mende ŋaiꞌe ŋaiꞌe gwande ŋoihmbwaip potopoi ŋaiye mende hwap pe, ofa mune teter sai ŋaiye ka se plihe ongohe hwap, pakai.
Ŋaiye ka tuꞌe luku pe, poi ya hiꞌgwirnge ŋaiye Got ka ende wusyep kot me lenge miyeꞌ tuweinge lalme pe, kin ka ende wusyep me lenge wachaih kin pe, ka iche lenge el nih ŋaiye tikin riri nihe supule.
Ŋaiye miyeꞌ ende si nengelyembe wusyep erŋeme tikin Moses no, miyeꞌ hoi lakai hun yanange pupwa kin yal halhale pe, yukur ka se ŋoihginirme miyeꞌ uku, pakai. Tinge yonombe kin nule.

Taꞌe luku pe, yip ŋoiheryembe taꞌe la ŋai me miyeꞌ ŋaiye naŋaꞌe teket me Talah tikin Got? Miyeꞌ uku ka ambaꞌe hwap embere pupwa. Wim tikin Krais ŋende bongolme kontrak ambaran. Pe ki ŋende miyeꞌ uku narp miyeꞌ tikin Got pe, kin narp holi, bwore mise supule. Kom tukwini pe, miyeꞌ uku ŋende wim tikin Krais nal luh pakaiye. Pe ki ŋende pupwa supule nalme Yipihinge tikin Got ŋaiye pwal poi ŋoihginir.
Poi sisyeme ŋaiye Got ŋanange taꞌe leꞌe,

content.text: Tuwaꞌe hwap pe, luku wah ŋam.
Hwap ŋaiye tinge yende, ma mende tuwaꞌe milme tinge pe,
ma mende yumbune tinge.

content: Topoꞌe kin plihe ŋanange na,

content.text: Lahmborenge ka iyarꞌe ŋaimune ŋaiye tinge yende el kot.

content: Poi lalme ya hiꞌ gwirnge ŋembere sekete ŋaiye ya tumbe mi moto syep tikin Got ŋaiye narp laip.
Yukur pa yusme ŋoiheryembe mise yip
Te plihe ŋoiheryembe yil ŋaiye somohonme. Ŋup uku ŋaiye yip yate tas yirise tikin Got pe, yip yambaꞌe nihe syohe wula wula sekete. Kom nihe syohe luku yukur tale yip, pakai!
Ŋup syeꞌ pe, tinge yende yip jan ŋembep lenge mitiŋ lalme pe, tinge jonombaiꞌe yip yende yumbune yip. Ŋup syeꞌ pe, yip yal topoꞌe lenge mitiŋ uku ŋaiye yambaꞌe nihe syohe pe, yip yungwisme tinge.

O yip ŋoihginirme lenge miyeꞌ ŋaiye tinge yember yal yoto mwahupwaiꞌe, topoꞌe yip yungwisme tinge. Topoꞌe ŋupe ŋaiye lenge miyeꞌ yate yambaꞌe ŋaiꞌe ŋaiꞌe yip pe, yip pa hriphrip. Detale, yip sisyeme nange ŋaiꞌe ŋaiꞌe bwore bwore yip teter ŋanar moihlaꞌ pe, luku ka inir nye nyermbe.
Taꞌe luku pe, yukur pa yusme ŋoiheryembe mise yip, na pakai. Pa jin bongole pe, mindemboi pa yambaꞌe yitini embere sekete.
Yip pa jin bongole no, pa junde ŋasande tikin Got. Taꞌe luku pe, pa yambaꞌe ŋaiꞌe ŋaiꞌe bwore bwore ŋaiye somohon Got nupwaiꞌe wusyep nange ka yul yip.
Ki taꞌe wusyep ŋaiye sai nato Tup tikin Got ŋanange na,

content.text: Ŋup yukur sokoloh, ŋup si miꞌe sehei ŋaiye miyeꞌ uku de ka ot.
Kin se ka ot hihwaiye.
Miyeꞌ bwore bwarme ŋam
ŋaiye ŋoihmbwaip kin ka teŋei bongol me Got pe, ka orp laip.
Kom ŋaiye lahende ka plihe bunjenge ŋoihmbwaip pe,
ŋam yukur ma se hriphrip me kin.

content: Poi yukur lenge miyeꞌ tuweinge ŋaiye ya se bunjenge ŋoihmbwaip poi no, ya talai, pakai. Poi miyeꞌ tuweinge ŋaiye ŋoihmbwaip poi teŋeime Got bongol pe, ya mambaꞌe laip bwore.
